hints.title: Multiset Subsetting
hints.text: A candidate word can be formed if and only if each character frequency in the word does not exceed its frequency in chars.

hints.title: Alphabet Frequency Tally
hints.text: Count frequencies of each letter in the reference string chars into a fixed-size array of length 26.

hints.title: Word Validation and Length Sum
hints.text: For each candidate word, check whether its character counts are <= reference counts. If valid, add length(word) to total.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Re-searching chars for each letter without frequency counts takes quadratic time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting frequencies with a 26-element array takes constant space and checks each word in time proportional to its length.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should implement clean multiset frequency comparison bounded by alphabet size 26.
complexity.notes: Every character in chars can be used at most once per candidate word.
